name: portfolio-website
description: Professional portfolio website with frontend/backend separation

scripts.build: echo 'Building for production...' && npm run optimize-assets && npm run validate-php
scripts.optimize-assets: echo 'Optimizing assets...' && find frontend/assets -name '*.css' -exec cssnano {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.validate-php: echo 'Validating PHP files...' && find frontend api -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \;

author: Suman Kumar Bhagat
